mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_shard_control SET initializing_command_id=#{key.command},revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE shard_id=0 AND mode='LEGACY' AND source_id IS NULL AND initializing_command_id IS NULL AND stop_reason IS NULL

UPDATE catalog_shard_control SET mode='QUIESCED',source_id=#{key.source},topology_version='advertiser-mod2-child-ad-mod2-v1', cluster_id=#{cluster},topic_id=#{topicId},topic_name=#{topic},writer_manifest=#{manifest,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, initializing_command_id=#{key.command},revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND mode='LEGACY' AND source_id IS NULL AND stop_reason IS NULL AND (initializing_command_id IS NULL OR initializing_command_id=#{key.command})
mapper.select: SELECT catalog_initial_layout(#{shard}) FROM catalog_shard_control WHERE shard_id=#{shard}
SELECT catalog_initial_page(#{kind},#{after}) FROM catalog_shard_control WHERE shard_id=#{shard}
SELECT target_id,target_owner_id FROM catalog_task_item WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND parent_scope='INITIALIZE' AND parent_command_id=#{command} AND state='READY' ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='COMPLETED',result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND parent_scope='INITIALIZE' AND parent_command_id=#{command} AND target_kind='AD' AND target_id=#{ad} AND state='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_task_item WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND parent_scope='INITIALIZE' AND parent_command_id=#{command} AND state<>'COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_shard_control SET mode='ACTIVE',initialization_ready=true,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND mode='QUIESCED' AND source_id=#{key.source} AND initializing_command_id=#{key.command} AND stop_reason IS NULL
